frozen_before: Any replay-order versus RUN-change association; amendment responds only to development nuisance stress
scope: Development nuisance-model revision, not independently validated replay or a calibrated biological association
rate_model: Per-cell Poisson log-link GLM with tensor-product position B-splines, circular direction and native-LFP theta harmonics, cubic standardized log speed, and spatial interactions with first direction/theta harmonics. Knots, scaling, mean-feature rate pseudocount and fitting use guarded training folds only. L2 penalty is 1 on summed negative log likelihood. scikit-learn PoissonRegressor is used. Any unavailable/nonconverged fold invalidates the entire period: never discard difficult cells or windows. PRE and POST are separate; no event spikes or future period spikes enter fitting.
theta_support: The original fixed-native-window screen and finite phase mask remain unchanged; no new pauses, units or animals selected
coordination: Same signed 5-60 ms physical-lag cross-products, PRE POST and POST-minus-PRE; zero-spike bins retained and clock gaps not concatenated
preceding_coordination: PRE endpoint retained; still must be included in the future calibrated association
claim_boundary: A development stress pass is not full null calibration. Smooth nuisance rates are a model assumption; spatial/phase interactions, low support and regression-to-mean require separate validation before biological interpretation. PF theta remains missing.
